scope: Fixed-baseline candidate comparison/review software through original Core/SQLite approved inputs, application cache, original task book and public completion decoder, with separately qualified real Task72 candidate/hardware provenance.
evidence_policy: The exact completed task-outcome Work receipt and separate review qualify evaluation/review software under the approved workflow-only testing policy. This feature matrix is declarative; no real model quality score or public host/parent pass.

preserved_failed_verification.failure: The routing test incorrectly expected independently available evaluation checks to disappear when only the controller test file was missing. The planner correctly retained those checks and selected generic coverage with the full controller suite.
preserved_failed_verification.correction: Assert that controller narrowing is disabled and generic coverage remains. Require evaluation checks to disappear only when one of their own required files is unavailable. A nonregular controller source still refuses policy hashing.

covered: Lower, equal and higher recorded baseline measurements preserve model, data, recipe, proposal and task lineage.
Source metrics, declared protocol, sample bounds and computed loss delta must agree.
Provider mutations and awaited policy callbacks cannot change the owned reply.
Actor, client, workspace, host and ModelRead changes cannot disclose the report.
Raw metadata, private paths and training text remain outside the public response.
Missing comparisons, current files and hardware stay unmeasured; measurement-only values never become quality or readiness passes.
Review never redispatches training or automatically saves the candidate.
limitations: All comparison metrics are deterministic software fixtures. No real model is evaluated or scored. This is the approved evaluation-software acceptance policy, not a claim about learned model quality.
Real candidate, hardware and owned cleanup are supplied only by the separately accepted Task72 run at its exact Source. Controlled metrics must not be attributed to that real model.
Public Desktop/Managed host delivery and generation/import remain separate Task74/75 requirements and prevent parent qualification.
Historical failed runs and old unknown owners remain preserved. Review requires separate approval before saving a generated Model.

real_candidate_support.facts: Real CPU training,12verified files/5checkpoint files, original task/model/data/pipeline correlation and confirmed new cleanup. No comparison score was computed for this candidate.
